title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: bring your own detections as custom indicators
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the documented, administrator-configured preview from the roadmap's overdue general availability target. The policy selection route is supported, but its path should include the threshold page already described in the note.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to accept customers' own activity indicators from homegrown systems, SIEM/UEBA platforms and line-of-business applications for existing Insider Risk Management playbooks.
claims.quote: Allow customers to bring their own user activity indicators from homegrown, SIEM/UEBA platforms, or other line-of-business applications, and leverage them in existing Insider Risk Management playbooks.

claims.claim: Custom indicators can incorporate Salesforce and Dropbox activities alongside built-in detections.
claims.quote: you might want to extend your detections to include Salesforce and Dropbox activities and use them alongside the built-in detections provided by insider risk management

claims.claim: Identified insider risks can lead to investigation cases.
claims.quote: After identifying the risks, you can take action to mitigate these risks, and if necessary open investigation cases and take appropriate legal action.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The connector and upload script authenticate using a registered Microsoft Entra application.
claims.quote: When you create this app, Microsoft Entra ID can authenticate the connector when it runs and attempts to access your organization. Use this app to authenticate the script

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The sample upload script accepts the Microsoft Entra application secret as a parameter.
claims.quote: .\HRConnector.ps1 -tenantId <tenantId> -appId <appId>  -appSecret <appSecret>  -jobId <jobId>  -filePath '<filePath>'

claims.claim: The sample script is not supported under Microsoft's standard support programmes.
claims.quote: This sample script isn't supported under any Microsoft standard support program or service.

claims.claim: The upload script requires webhook.ingestion.office.com to be allowed through the firewall.
claims.quote: Make sure to add the webhook.ingestion.office.com domain to your firewall allowlist for your organization. If this domain is blocked, the script doesn't run.

claims.quote: After selecting your custom trigger or indicator, make sure to set a custom threshold (don't use the default thresholds).

claims.claim: Trigger thresholds cannot be set when Use only as a triggering event without any thresholds is selected.

claims.quote: If any record in the uploaded CSV file contains the same timestamp and UPN as other records in the file, the record is dropped.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft instructs waiting 24 hours after updating custom indicators and associated policies before uploading.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Insider Risk Management requires a supported Microsoft 365 subscription and appropriate licences assigned to users, supporting the per-user entitlement description.
claims.quote: To access and use Insider Risk Management, administrators need to verify their organization has a supported subscription and assign the appropriate licenses to users.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Licence; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A separate licence specific to custom indicators or the Insider Risk Indicators connector is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management custom indicators license pricing billing connector; licensing custom indicators Microsoft 365 E5 service description. Read configure, import-insider-risk-indicators, policy-indicators and Purview service description; no separate custom-indicator SKU.

claims.claim: The billing page meters Insider Risk Management cloud storage, cloud service and Microsoft Fabric indicators using data security processing units under pay-as-you-go.
claims.quote: Insider Risk Management indicators that detect activity in cloud storage apps (Box, Dropbox, Google Drive), cloud services (AWS, Azure), and Microsoft Fabric (Power BI) are billed on data security processing units.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Meter
claims.claim: The billing page does not list custom indicators among its metered indicator categories.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management custom indicators bring your own detections license pricing billing connector. Read purview-billing-models in full and policy-indicators: published billing categories do not name custom indicators.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Meter; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A meter or charge specifically applicable to imported custom-indicator data is not published.
claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Management custom indicators bring your own detections license pricing billing connector. Read billing-models, policy-indicators, import-insider-risk-indicators, configure and Purview service description; no charge specified for this custom-indicator ingestion.

claims.claim: Learn suggests scheduling the upload script to run daily.
claims.quote: After you run the script, consider scheduling a task to run it automatically on a daily basis so the most current data is uploaded to the Microsoft cloud.

claims.claim: The CSV data should be refreshed on a similar schedule to the upload script.
claims.quote: This schedule requires updating the data in the CSV file on a similar (if not the same) schedule so that it contains the latest information.

claims.claim: Insider Risk Management is available in tenants hosted in geographical regions and countries supported by Azure service dependencies.
claims.quote: Insider Risk Management is currently available in tenants hosted in geographical regions and countries supported by Azure service dependencies.

claims.quote: Assign the Data Connector Admin role to the user who creates the connector in Step 3. This role is required to add connectors on the Data connectors page in the Microsoft Purview portal.

claims.quote: Configure policies and settings | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No

claims.claim: Multiple role groups contain the Data Connector Admin role by default.
claims.quote: Multiple role groups include this role by default.

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember -Identity "Insider Risk Management" -Member "<user-UPN>" adds a user to that management role group.
claims.quote: Use the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet to add members to a management role group. ... The Identity parameter specifies the role group ... User ID or user principal name (UPN)

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The connector creation entry point is Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Data connectors > My connectors > Add connector > Insider Risk Indicators (preview).
claims.quote: Select Settings > Data connectors. ... Select My connectors, then select Add connector. ... From the list, select Insider Risk Indicators (preview).

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; controls[2].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: After the connector exists, create custom indicators through Insider Risk Management > Settings > Policy indicators > Custom Indicators > Add custom indicator.
claims.quote: In Insider Risk Management settings, select Policy indicators and then select the Custom Indicators tab. ... Select Add custom indicator.

claims.claim: The Data leaks example proceeds from Insider Risk Management > Policies > Create policy through Policy template, Content to prioritize and Triggers for this policy to Policy indicators and a custom indicator.
claims.quote: On the Policy indicators page ... Select the indicators you want to apply to the policy. ... On the Decide whether to use default or custom indicator thresholds page ... Specify custom thresholds
claims.fix: Extend controls[3].ui.path and its rendered path to 'Insider Risk Management > Policies > Create policy > Policy template > policy category > Data leaks > Content to prioritize > Triggers for this policy > Policy indicators > custom indicator > Decide whether to use default or custom indicator thresholds > Specify custom thresholds'. Retain the existing note's workflow choices. The cited configure page documents the added threshold step; the current path already reaches the indicator selection control.

claims.quote: Searched: Insider Risk Indicators connector create API; custom indicators create policy PowerShell API New-InsiderRiskPolicy Set-InsiderRiskPolicy automation. Read import-insider-risk-indicators and configure: automation uploads data, not connector configuration.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not document an API or PowerShell operation that creates or configures these custom indicators.
claims.quote: Searched: custom indicators insider API PowerShell; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell insider risk policy indicator. Read policy-indicators and import-insider-risk-indicators; results describe portal configuration or unrelated threat-intelligence commands, not custom-indicator configuration.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not document automation selecting these custom indicators or thresholds in an Insider Risk Management policy.
claims.quote: Searched: custom indicators create policy PowerShell API New-InsiderRiskPolicy Set-InsiderRiskPolicy automation; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell insider risk policy indicator. Read configure, policy-indicators and policies search excerpts: portal workflow only.

claims.claim: Only Number fields can be used to set custom-indicator thresholds.
claims.quote: Only fields that have a Number data type appear in the Data from mapping file list, since a Number data type is required to set a threshold value.

claims.claim: The connector configuration maps an Event time (UTC time) field from the CSV.
claims.quote: Enter the values for Event time (UTC time) and Microsoft 365 user email address based on the appropriate values from the CSV file. These fields are mandatory for the connector.

claims.claim: The connector configuration maps a Microsoft 365 user email address field from the CSV.
claims.quote: Enter the values for Event time (UTC time) and Microsoft 365 user email address based on the appropriate values from the CSV file. These fields are mandatory for the connector.

claims.claim: Custom-indicator triggers and insights appear in the Alerts dashboard, Activity explorer and User timeline.
claims.quote: After adding the custom indicator to your policies, the triggers and insights generated based on the custom indicators appear in the Alerts dashboard, Activity explorer, and User timeline.

claims.claim: The connector must exist before creating its custom indicator, which must exist before it can be selected in a policy.
claims.quote: To create a custom indicator to import third-party indicator data, you must first create an Insider Risk Indicators connector ... Now you can add the custom indicator to an insider risk policy

claims.claim: The Content to prioritize page offers I don't want to specify priority content right now.
claims.quote: I don't want to specify priority content right now. Select this option to skip the priority content detail pages in the workflow.

claims.claim: Data leaks policies offer User performs an exfiltration activity triggering event and a Use default thresholds (Recommended) choice for triggering events.
claims.quote: If you select the User performs an exfiltration activity triggering event option, you must select one or more of the listed indicators ... Choose either the Use default thresholds (Recommended) or Use custom thresholds for the triggering events.

claims.claim: After selecting policy indicators, the workflow offers Specify custom thresholds on the next page.
claims.quote: On the Decide whether to use default or custom indicator thresholds page ... Choose either the Use default thresholds for all indicators or Specify custom thresholds for the selected policy indicators.
